sources.snippet: Tutorial - Temporal AI Agent This repository is the companion repository for the tutorial How To Build a Durable Agentic AI with Temporal and Python. The code in this repository supports learning how to build a durable agentic AI with Temporal. It is inspired by Steve Androulakis' agengit AI implementation using Temporal.
